sources.title: GitHub - bonelag/OVoice: High-Quality Voice Cloning TTS for 600 ...
sources.snippet: OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a novel diffusion language model-style architecture, it generates high-quality speech with superior inference speed, supporting voice cloning and voice design.
